verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented pre-meeting feature that surfaces past meetings with the same attendees or generates a brief of open threads before a call. What exists is adjacent only: searchable past transcripts, an MCP server that answers ad-hoc questions about meetings, and API endpoints listing notes (with attendee emails) and action items that a developer could use to build such a brief.

support.subject: As a founder, I walk into each meeting prepped — the tool surfaces past meetings with the same people and a brief of open threads before the call
